# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LAYER 1 — BUS (JetStream config)                               sync-wave: "2"
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# platform-nats-streams: the Stream / KeyValue CRs in platform/nats/streams/.
# The NACK controller (edge-nack, wave 1) reconciles them into JetStream, so this
# Application syncs after NACK. platform-nats does not apply this directory
# (directory.recurse: false), so before this Application the CRs were applied by
# hand with kubectl on 2026-07-07 and nothing reconciled them.
#
# Adoption safety:
# - Every CR in Git matches the live CR spec, so the first sync changes no stream
#   or bucket configuration. The only spec change is `preventDelete: true`.
# - Every CR sets `preventDelete: true`: deleting a CR (or this Application)
#   removes only the Kubernetes object. NACK keeps the JetStream stream and its data.
# - prune is OFF and there is deliberately no resources-finalizer, so removing a
#   file here or deleting this Application never deletes a CR.
# - ServerSideApply: Git owns only the fields it sets. Live `spec.servers` was set
#   out of band (kubectl patch, carries credentials) and stays untouched.
# - kv-feed-config.yaml is excluded: the live bucket was created by an app (R1)
#   and has no CR. Adopting it needs the full live config first (see that file).
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: platform-nats-streams
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "2"
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/onemindos/omos.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: platform/nats/streams
    directory:
      recurse: false
      exclude: "kv-feed-config.yaml"
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: nats
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: false
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
      - ServerSideApply=true
